# Holder

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

The FPS player's hold: picks up the dynamic body looked at and holds it in front of the eyes on a BodyDrive.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `reach` | `float` | m, to pick up (3) |
| `distance` | `float` | m in front of the eyes (1.2; the wheel changes it) |
| `min_distance` | `float` | m (0.6) |
| `max_distance` | `float` | m (2.5) |
| `wheel_step` | `float` | m per notch (0.15) |
| `max_force` | `float` | N per axis of the drive (1500): heavier stays on the ground |
| `max_torque` | `float` | N m per axis (300) |
| `throw_speed` | `float` | m/s (8) |
| `break_distance` | `float` | m off its place: dropped (1.5) |
| `held` | `entt::entity` | written: the body held |
| `held_rotation` | `glm::quat` | written: of the body in the view's frame |
| `was_interact` | `bool` | written: interact as last seen |
| `was_primary` | `bool` | written: primary as last seen |

## Notes

Needs an input component and a PlayerView. Written by Hold.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: Hold, PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Hold](../systems/Hold.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick, step, pick, drop | tuning read; distance changed by the wheel; held, held_rotation, was_interact, was_primary written |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeFPSPlayer) | the FPS player's pick up |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
